name: svdp-servware
description: Record St. Vincent de Paul food and gift card deliveries in ServWare.
long_description: Guides a volunteer through recording a delivery night: lists open assistance requests, confirms gift card amounts, splits deliveries by volunteer group, and writes the results back to ServWare.

servware_user.title: ServWare username
servware_user.description: The username your SVdP conference gave you for servware.org.

servware_pass.title: ServWare password
servware_pass.description: Your servware.org password. Stored in your Mac keychain, never shown in chat.
